findings: The 2026-11-07 canonical capture only supplies two variant links and a purpose statement (new 5-14). May 6, 2026 is the actual fetch date of the full paired guide, despite its filename. May says the merchant needs customer consent to save the method and arranges a mandate for future use. The merchant server attaches the method to a customer-configured Accounts v2 Account or Customers v1 Customer and distinguishes customer_account from customer where shown in Direct API requests. May describes Accounts v2 as generally available for Connect and public preview requiring a preview version for other Stripe users (old 29-44 and 136-148).

Checkout mode setup creates a Session server-side, redirects the customer to Stripe's hosted URL for authorization and illustrates mobile redirect or desktop QR in testing. This is saving through Checkout, not an assertion of a charge. The May Direct API has a SetupIntent with usage on_session or off_session, client secret transport and confirmUpiSetup with return_url and online customer acceptance, distinct from confirming an INR PaymentIntent with setup_future_usage=off_session to initiate payment and save (old 75-107, 180-248, 251-363, 365-462).

May reuse creates and confirms a new PaymentIntent using the same PaymentMethod ID from the previous SetupIntent or PaymentIntent. Use off_session=true when the customer is outside checkout. The on-session path still redirects to the UPI app even for a saved method. May's manual handling uses requires_action and hosted instructions or QR, and detaching a reusable PaymentMethod sends mandate.updated and payment_method.detached (old 119-121, 464-504, 506-571).

contributions.original_prompts:
New raw `raw/stripe-payments-upi-set-up-future-payments-2026-11-07.md`. Prior raw `raw/stripe-upi-set-up-future-payments-2025.md`. Current summaries `wiki/sources/source-stripe-upi-set-up-future-payments.md`.

- Q1. For `https://docs.stripe.com/payments/upi/set-up-future-payments`, what documented behavior, prerequisites, actors and state transitions does the complete new capture establish? How do these compare with the matched prior capture and each mapped summary?

- Q2. Which changes are substantive, presentational or navigation-only? Identify the exact dated qualifications, conflicts and reciprocal routes that the proposed disposition should preserve.

reviewed_answers.Q1: The November 7 capture at https://docs.stripe.com/payments/upi/set-up-future-payments is a Checkout and Direct API variant index. It states the goal of saving UPI for future use but gives no prerequisites or state transitions itself (new raw lines 5-14). The May 6 guide requires customer permission for saving and describes arranging a mandate up front, with a customer-configured Account or Customer for later reuse. Its server creates Checkout setup Sessions for hosted customer authorization, or a SetupIntent that the client confirms with confirmUpiSetup, or a confirm=true INR PaymentIntent intended to pay and save. Reuse calls a new PaymentIntent with the same PaymentMethod ID and off_session=true outside checkout. The on-session path redirects to the UPI app even with a saved method, the manual PaymentIntent can require action, and detach emits mandate.updated and payment_method.detached. Setup or return alone establishes no completed payment (old raw lines 12-44, old raw lines 75-121, old raw lines 180-248, old raw lines 341-375 and old raw lines 464-571). source-stripe-upi-set-up-future-payments.md retains core paths but omits the consent and object boundary and overstates address requiredness and immediate charge.
reviewed_answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/upi/set-up-future-payments the November transition from a full inline May guide to two links is navigation-only (old raw lines 8-14 and old raw lines 109-121, new raw lines 5-14). This does not verify changed or discarded UPI behavior. Retain the May 6, 2026 evidence with actual fetch date, Accounts v2 public-preview condition outside Connect, customer consent, regular on-session redirect, and distinct off-session reuse and detach events. In source-stripe-upi-set-up-future-payments.md correct the independently pre-existing Checkout example, address requiredness and state wording. May illustrates an Indian billing address and line2 without stating universal requiredness, and the Checkout sample selects UPI within a card-plus-UPI list. Preserve the nested qrcode response object while noting the old prose path discrepancy (old raw lines 75-107, old raw lines 191-248 and old raw lines 542-571). Keep the raw route and restore a reciprocal Stripe Real-Time Payments concept link. The November variants remain navigation.
